title: Authentic Scutes
description: Makes armadillo scutes obtaining more realistic
body:
## About
**Authentic Scutes** revamps how armadillo scutes are obtained, aiming for a more realistic experience. Armadillo scutes can no longer be acquired by simply waiting for them to drop or by brushing armadillos. With this mod, the only way to obtain armadillo scutes is, unfortunately, by killing armadillos.
